issues.description: searchTodos interpolates the caller-controlled keyword directly into SQL.
issues.suggestion: Use a parameterized query and bind the wildcard search value.

issues.description: searchTodosByStatus concatenates an unvalidated completion value into SQL.
issues.suggestion: Validate the boolean and bind it as a query parameter.

issues.description: getTodosByUser interpolates userId into a JOIN query.
issues.suggestion: Use a parameterized query with userId as a bound parameter.

codeQuality.summary: The three added search helpers introduce direct SQL string interpolation in database queries.

untestedPaths.reasoning: New search behavior needs matching and injection-safety coverage.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test keyword matching and malicious keyword input while asserting bound parameters.

untestedPaths.reasoning: New status filtering accepts user-controlled input.
New user-scoped retrieval is an injection-sensitive data-access path.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test user matching and injection-like IDs with parameterized db calls.

testCoverage.summary: Existing todo tests do not provide sufficient evidence for the three new query helpers; behavior and security properties need regression tests.

suggestions.description: Standardize all new database access on the parameterized-query style already used by CRUD operations.
suggestions.before: Template literals/string concatenation passed to db.query.
suggestions.after: Static SQL text plus positional parameters.
suggestions.benefits: Removes injection risk and makes query behavior consistent.

suggestions.description: Centralize safe filter construction if more search filters are added.
suggestions.after: Typed query helper for approved filters and bound parameters.

refactorings.summary: The primary refactoring is to align the new functions with the module’s existing parameterized-query design.

recommendations.description: Replace all three direct SQL interpolations with parameterized queries.
Add regression tests for search, status filtering, user filtering, and injection-like inputs.
